text: The dusk would not permit him to distinguish what it was, but he bade Michael go on. “This seems a wild place,” said Michael; “there is no house hereabout, don’t your honour think we had better turn back?” “Go a little farther, and if we see no house then, we will return to the road,” replied St. Aubert. Michael proceeded with reluctance, and the extreme slowness of his pace made St. Aubert look again from the window to hasten him, when again he saw the same figure. He was somewhat startled: probably the gloominess of the spot made him more liable to alarm than usual; however this might be, he now stopped Michael, and bade him call to the person in the avenue. “Please your honour, he may be a robber,” said Michael.
